purpose: Independently derive and verify the adopted one-sided calibration count checks while preserving missing results, cohort separation and the absence of scientific authentication.

scope.excluded: The separate request-file CLI and its tests are parent-owned. No owned simulation runner, source authentication, final seed reservation, freshness assertion, certificate or model-adequacy evidence is implemented or established by this count kernel.

fixture_provenance.derivation: Direct integer sums of comb(n,j)*a**j*(b-a)**(n-j), divided by b**n, for inclusive lower/upper binomial tails. Solve tail=1/20 on the 2^40 grid; verify both endpoint inequalities. Exact n=1 roots and complementary endpoints cross-check the result. Threshold decisions use exact tails at 1/10 and 7/10, not decimal displays.
fixture_provenance.external_reference_access: The existing study note links NIST and SciPy. A new public-document retrieval did not complete before cancellation; no fresh external-reference verification is claimed. Expectations derive from the adopted local contract and independently executed arithmetic.

scientific_interpretation.authority: D081 and research-contract/1.0 section 11; section 5.4 separates the 80 percent information-study design target.
scientific_interpretation.error_gate: Each complete 256-world false_support, boundary_decisive or joint_miscoverage cohort uses a one-sided exact 95 percent upper bound at most 0.10.
scientific_interpretation.detection_gate: A complete 256-world detection cohort uses a one-sided exact 95 percent lower bound at least 0.70. The 80 percent point target is reported separately.
scientific_interpretation.boundary_event: At true theta=delta, either false support or false negative is an erroneous decisive classification. The supplied Boolean must describe their union, including the applicable nondirectional boundary. A 17-plus-17 disjoint-tail fixture has 34 events and fails; two separately passing tails do not replace the union.
scientific_interpretation.joint_event: One event represents any required interval missing its own truth in a joint claim batch. Instruments and individual claims within one world are not extra independent repetitions.
scientific_interpretation.unknowns: Missing or unavailable events remain NOT_ASSESSED with the planned denominator of 256; no renormalized point or bound is issued. The future owned runner must authenticate whether a scientific abstention has a known event value, distinct from a technical/unknown outcome. This kernel does not choose that policy.
scientific_interpretation.cohorts: Each declared world law is assessed separately. All four criterion types are required; applicable stress declarations refer to existing cohorts. Shared source artifacts and repeated world identifiers across different criteria are allowed; within each cohort the 256 planned identifiers and observations are unique.
scientific_interpretation.confidence_scope: One-sided 95 percent bounds are pointwise and assume independent outer worlds under the declared law. A conjunction of count checks does not certify a simultaneous confidence statement, market adequacy, or full-process calibration.

fixed_oracles.point_204_of_256: 51/64; below 4/5 although the lower-bound calibration check passes
fixed_oracles.point_205_of_256: 205/256; at least 4/5 and the lower-bound calibration check passes
fixed_oracles.coarse_display: At bits=8, U17 is 26/256 (above 0.10) and L192 is 179/256 (below 0.70). The exact tail comparisons still pass both counts; admission must not depend on outward display rounding.
fixed_oracles.failure_and_incompleteness: A completed 18-error failure remains visible while an unavailable detection world makes the overall status NOT_ASSESSED.
fixed_oracles.stress_separation: A separate zero-error null cohort cannot hide the original 18-error failed cohort by pooling.
fixed_oracles.limits: One through 256 trials and bits 8 through 64 for the arithmetic helper; exactly 256 predeclared worlds per cohort and at most 16 cohorts for assessment.

findings.scope: The exercised arithmetic, complete-cohort checks, schema/type gates, failure precedence, no-pooling rule, mutation isolation and authority disclaimers. This is not proof of correctness outside the tested envelope.

findings.finding: PASS_COUNTS_ONLY remains scientific_readiness false and n_min null. Top-level input_authentication, freshness, event_semantics and applicability_evidence stay UNVERIFIED; an applicability reason or source reference is not empirical certification.

coverage: 18 frozen brackets and independently recomputed exact tail inequalities
Exact endpoints, closed-form roots and strict integer/resource validation
All four count criteria, distinct calibration versus point-design thresholds
Coarse display cannot change exact threshold decisions
Empty, missing and unavailable records never renormalize
Failure-plus-incomplete precedence and unpooled stress worlds
Per-cohort ID uniqueness and manifest/world/source binding
Malformed states, Boolean substitutions, forged metadata and applicability declarations
Canonical request hashing, unchanged inputs, detached outputs and cached result isolation
Stable counts under record permutation, with changed input hash
verification.not_rerun: The parent primary tests and CLI tests were not independently rerun; this report counts only the 17 named independent tests. No full-suite claim.

warranted_conclusion: The tested kernel implements the adopted count comparisons and explicit incomplete-result behavior. Fixed independent expectations remain unchanged. No estimator has thereby passed fresh empirical calibration; supplied Boolean outcomes and source declarations remain unauthenticated.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether an owned runner generates the correct boundary, mixed-effect joint-coverage, heavy-tail, overlap and common-shock events under adequate population laws.
Fresh final seed separation, frozen estimator versions, authenticated event/source binding, process isolation and actual retained simulation failures.
Applicability justifications and dependence between outer worlds; simulation model adequacy for market inference.
Scientific certification, information-target admission, full-process calibration and economic usefulness.
next_action: Integrate the verified kernel with a separately reviewed owned calibration manifest and runner that retains sources, seeds, execution outcomes and all gaps. Keep count checks descriptive until those authentication, freshness, event-semantics and applicability prerequisites are satisfied.
